title: the whole game is free, i just want feedback
author: naveed_qasim56
selftext:
The Host’s Table is free. All five tables, every boss, the Unsated and the ending, right here in your browser. The Mac and Windows downloads are free too.

[https://naveedqasim.itch.io/hosts-table](https://naveedqasim.itch.io/hosts-table)

This is my first game, and right now I care more about people playing it than about sales. If you enjoy it, the tip jar is there, but please don’t feel you have to.

*^(\*full disclosure: i’m a designer, not an artist or a coder, though i’ve worked on games throughout my career. i used ai tools to help build this, but the design and every decision in it are mine.)*

comments.author: santigv1500
comments.body: Card games aren't really my favorite, but I'd still play this one! I have to say, the art direction looks great. The voiceover explaining the game feels a little out of place with the overall atmosphere, though. I'd suggest trying a few different options to see what fits better.

comments.author: Tobias-StaldieGames
comments.body: The visuals, mood and graphic look very good and fit well together. If I would be a card game enjoyer I would definitely try this out :)

comments.author: Slipfacegame
comments.body: Great visual and sounds. I really liked the game. My game stopped after few levels. Maybe I didn't just get the mechanics. I lost one fight and then there was no way back. The enemy was getting better cards and my new cards were all the time worse. Special abilities of cards should be some how visible. Now difficult to see. I would also develop the start story.
